## 5. PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS IDENTIFIED  
### High Priority (Address Q1 2026)  
1. **Account Closure Documentation** (HIGH)
- Implement mandatory closure letter procedure
- Document closure reason in system
- Expected completion: Feb 2026
- Owner: Head of Operations  
2. **Standing Order Audit Trail** (HIGH)
- Log all modifications with timestamp/user
- System enhancement required
- Expected completion: March 2026
- Owner: CTO

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Documentation Gap - Q1 2026
raw_entities.description: Audit identified absence of mandatory closure letter procedure and system documentation of account closure reasons. Finding requires implementation of formal closure documentation process with expected completion in February 2026.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Audit Trail Gap - Q1 2026
raw_entities.description: Audit identified lack of comprehensive audit trail logging for standing order modifications. Finding requires system enhancement to capture all modifications with timestamp and user identification, with expected completion in March 2026.

raw_entities.name: Implement Account Closure Documentation Procedure

raw_entities.name: Enhance Standing Order Modification Logging System
raw_entities.description: System enhancement action to implement comprehensive audit trail logging for all standing order modifications, capturing timestamp and user identity. Assigned to CTO with deadline of March 2026.
